svg.title: Land surveyor — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as land surveyor, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A horizontal surveying telescope sits on a clear spread three-legged tripod. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
